name: strixhalo-recipes
title_zh: 本地大模型跑分前先查这张配方表
tagline_zh: 别人晒的 Strix Halo 跑分你复现不出？它把 llama.cpp 的启动参数、硬件配置。
tagline_en: Can't reproduce someone's Strix Halo numbers? This packs llama.cpp flags, hardware, and test commands into.
desc_en: Use when the user wants to run, replicate, benchmark, or contribute a local-LLM serving setup (llama.cpp via llama-swap/llama-server on unified-memory Linux hardware like Strix Halo). Covers finding an existing tested recipe, replicating it, running its tests, submitting evidence results, and adding new recipes with proper lineage and annotations.
why_zh: 把「能跑」变成「可复现」：每条配方记录硬件、参数、依赖的完整血缘，测试结果可追溯。
why_en: Turns 'it runs' into 'it reproduces': each recipe records full lineage of hardware, flags, and deps; results are traceable, and.
limit_zh: 只认统一内存架构的 Linux 设备（如 Strix Halo）。
limit_en: Linux only, unified-memory chips (e.g., Strix Halo), llama.cpp family only. No speed tuning, no help with custom flags outside a recipe.
title_en: Look up a tested recipe before benchmarking local LLMs
